name: com.scrapecrate/scrapecrate
title: ScrapeCrate
description: YouTube, Google Maps, Trustpilot and Meta Ad Library data as tools, paid with one credit balance.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: YouTube API: Get a transcript. The transcript of a video as timed segments and plain text. Without `lang` you get the video's default caption track. format=vtt puts a WebVTT subtitle file in `text`; format=chunks returns `chunks` (index, text, start, end in seconds) with the chunk_size and chunk_overlap used: whole segments merged into pieces of about chunk_size characters, ready for embeddings. Price: 1 credit per call; failed calls are free.

lang.description: Language code (e.g. `en`, `it`, `pt-BR`); auto-translated when the video doesn't have it

format.description: `json` (segments + text), `text` or `srt`. `vtt` (WebVTT subtitles in `text`) or `chunks` (timestamped chunks for embeddings, in `chunks`).

chunk_size.description: `format=chunks` only: target characters per chunk (segments are never split)

chunk_overlap.description: `format=chunks` only: characters of whole segments repeated from the end of the previous chunk (less than `chunk_size`)

tools.name: youtube_transcript_languages
tools.description: YouTube API: List transcript languages. The caption tracks available for a video, manual and auto-generated. Price: 1 credit per call; failed calls are free.

tools.name: youtube_video

tools.name: youtube_video_chapters

tools.name: youtube_video_comments
tools.description: YouTube API: List video comments. Top-level comments of a video with author, likes, replies count, date and pinned flag. With include_replies=true each comment also carries `replies` (comment_id, parent_id, text, author, like_count, published_at), up to replies_per_comment each. Replies are billed like comments: 1 credit per 100 comments and replies together. Price: 1 credit per 100 items returned (min 1); with include_replies=true the nested items (up to replies_per_comment per item) count as items too; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

include_replies.description: Also return each comment's replies, in its `replies` list (billed like comments)

tools.name: youtube_channel

tools.name: youtube_playlist_videos
tools.description: YouTube API: List playlist videos. The videos of a public playlist in playlist order, page by page: follow `pagination.next_cursor`; every page costs the same, the last one like the first. `meta.total_videos` and `meta.total_pages` give the size of the playlist (null when YouTube does not show it). Private and Mix playlists answer 404. Price: 1 credit per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

playlist_id.description: Playlist ID: the `list=` value of a playlist URL (`PL...`, `UU...`, `OLAK5uy_...`)

tools.name: ads_ads_search
tools.description: Meta Ad Library API: Search ads. Ads matching a keyword or an advertiser page, with filters, up to 30 per call. Every ad carries days_active (whole days from started_at to ended_at, or to today while it runs; null when unknown) and winning_score (0-100, null when days_active is null): long-running ads are the ones that pay off. score = L + V + R, with L = 70 x min(days_active, 90) / 90, V = 15 x min(variants_count - 1, 9) / 9 and R = 15 x min(log10(1 + EU reach) / 6, 1). The EU reach is only in the single-ad lookup, so in lists score = (L + V) x 100 / 85: a missing reach never lowers it. Rounded to the nearest integer. min_days_active and sort=longevity apply to the ads of the returned page, at the same price. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call). One of q, page_id is required.

page_id.description: Only ads of this advertiser page

sort.description: Order. `longevity` puts the longest-running ads of the page first.

min_days_active.description: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (applied to the returned page, same price)

limit.description: Ads per page (max 30, one page of the source)
